summary: Jackson County, WI steel fire lookout erected 1928 for the state conservation department; listed as removed with no date. No source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Built year (1928) and tower height (25 ft) agree between the Forest Lookouts page and the NGS datasheet, so both are kept. The Forest Lookouts page says only 'Removed' with no date, and no source gives a removal date. No staffing, fire or access source was found. Neither the Forest Lookouts page nor the FFLA entry gives a height; height_m (25 ft) is from the NGS station description. Record coordinates match the NGS position (44 14 53.09 N, 90 44 00.35 W). The NGS datasheet was retrieved 2026-10-10 and shows the station as still on file; it does not describe any surviving structure or marker.
